authority_scope: Explicit human approval of the current SSN/SOSA Deployment revision. Only this term is finalized; the separately governed SOSA-2023 track and all other mapping decisions are unchanged.

previous_formal_mapping_assertions.target: cco:PlannedAct and (ssn:deployedSystem some ssn:System) and (ssn:deployedOnPlatform some bfo:MaterialEntity)

question_response: SSN defines Deployment as deploying one or more Systems for a particular purpose and explicitly states that deployment may occur on a Platform. The alignment interprets purposeful positioning or installation of Systems as a CCO PlannedAct. The restriction ssn:deployedSystem some ssn:System requires at least one deployed System, reflecting the source definition's one-or-more commitment; the source universal restriction alone does not require such a witness. The converse is supported by the source axioms: ssn:hasDeployment is inverse to ssn:deployedSystem, and ssn:System restricts all hasDeployment values to ssn:Deployment. Thus an individual related by deployedSystem to a System is a Deployment, including an individual satisfying the proposed PlannedAct intersection. Platform involvement is optional, so a deployedOnPlatform existential is not a necessary condition. The retained source universal restriction still classifies any deployedOnPlatform value of a Deployment as a Platform. Removing the mandatory Platform witness does not prohibit Platform-based deployments.
